videos.script: A node goes down for a few minutes. The writes it missed do not vanish. {{hint}} The coordinator keeps them as hints, in a file named after the missing node, and replays them when it returns. You will read that file, and the log line that empties it. But hints expire, and they cover only what the coordinator saw. {{diverge}} So you make two replicas disagree on purpose. A read at ALL notices. {{digest}} The trace says digest mismatch, and the coordinator writes the newest value back to the stale replica. That is read repair. It fixes only what is read. Then repair itself. {{merkle}} Each replica hashes its data into a Merkle tree, and only the slices that differ are streamed. The log names every range out of sync, including the orders lesson 17 warned about. Full, then incremental. {{incremental}} Last, the schedule. {{schedule}} Every node, within gc grace. And what happens when nobody runs it: lesson 18's deleted row, coming back. {{zombie}}
